description: The line plot illustrates the performance of different models—ReDial, ReFICR, and their respective variants—measured by Recall@50 and NDCG@50 across varying depths of search, with the x-axis representing the search depth ranging from 1 to 5. The left y-axis shows Recall@50 values, while the right y-axis shows NDCG@50 values, both scaled from 0.15 to 0.60. The green solid line with circular markers represents Recall@50 for ReDial (Ours), starting at approximately 0.35 at depth 1 and increasing to 0.49 at depth 5. The green dotted line, representing Recall@50 for ReFICR, remains relatively stable at around 0.46 across all depths. The blue solid line with square markers, indicating NDCG@50 for ReDial (Ours), begins at about 0.16 at depth 1, rises to 0.18 by depth 3, and plateaus at 0.18 through depth 5. The blue dotted line, corresponding to NDCG@50 for ReFICR, stays constant at approximately 0.16 across all depths. The plot demonstrates that ReDial (Ours) outperforms ReFICR in both metrics as the search depth increases, with Recall@50 showing a clear upward trend and NDCG@50 stabilizing at a higher value.
